data.chunk: {"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cf8iZEsFgUVnLzi98DbpT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"A three-layer shell bonds the waterproof membrane between the face fabric and a thin inner scrim, so the membrane is protected from abrasion and body oils without needing a separate hanging liner — making the jacket lighter, less bulky, better packing, and more durable for hard use.
